follow_orders.title: Do You Always Follow Orders?
follow_orders.text: Do not stray from the path in Beyond the Gates of Sleep.

so_cute.title: Aww, But They're So Cute
so_cute.text: Do not defeat a single [[Zoog]] enemy in Beyond the Gates of Sleep.

losing_my_religion.title: Losing My Religion
losing_my_religion.text: In a single playthrough, find and uncover all 10 Signs of the Gods in The Search for Kadath.

cat_killer.title: Fantasy Flight Games (®) Does Not Condone Accomplishing This Achievement
cat_killer.text: Break the law of Ulthar in The Search for Kadath.

spy.title: Tactical Espionage Action
spy.text: Complete Dark Side of the Moon with each investigator's alarm level at zero.

moon_lizard.title: Moon Lizards? I Don't Believe They Exist
moon_lizard.text: Defeat the Moon Lizard in Dark Side of the Moon.

barkham.title: Barkham Horror Enthusiast
barkham.text: Defeat 1 or more Cats from Saturn using a fight ability on either a cat ally or a dog ally.

high_priest.title: Only Way To Be Sure
high_priest.text: Reduce the High Priest Not to Be Described to 1 remaining health, then shove it down a well anyway in Where the Gods Dwell.

hidden_nylar.title: Give Them Something To Talk About
hidden_nylar.text: In a single round, add every hidden form of Nyarlathotep to the victory display in Where the Gods Dwell.

final_form.title: This Isn't Even My Final Form!
final_form.text: Expose and then defeat Nyarlathotep's True Shape in Where the Gods Dwell.

dont_tell.title: Don't Tell Anyone, But...
dont_tell.text: Using the ability on The Great Hall, give 6 different hidden cards to another investigator in Where the Gods Dwell.

line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
line_in_the_sand.text: Win The Dream-Quest campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

dreamlands_expertise.title: Dreamlands Expertise
dreamlands_expertise.text: Win the The Dream-Quest campaign on Expert difficulty.

beware_black_cat.title: Beware The Black Cat
beware_black_cat.text: Complete The Dream-Eaters campaign with okay, fine, have it your way then recorded in your Campaign Log.

reunited.title: Reunited and it Feels So Good
reunited.text: Win The Dream-Eaters as an interconnected 8-part campaign, and have both groups reunite during the epilogue.
